is a derivative of tetracycline that possesses broad antimicrobial and antiinflammatory activities. Further, antiviral activity of doxycycline has been reported against retroviruses, and a significant reduction in retrovirus titre was observed after incubation of infected cells with doxycycline.\u0026nbsp; studies have shown that doxycycline inhibits dengue virus plaque formation by disrupting the conformational changes in the viral envelope that are necessary for virus entry.\u0026nbsp;studies also found the antidengue properties of doxycycline against all four dengue virus serotypes in vitro.\u0026nbsp;doxycycline interfered with dengue virus protease and impaired virus binding to the host cells, leading to reduced viral replication in infected cells.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EJNJ1802 Antiviral drug against dengue.
